text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
choice_data_list: You're even more fired up than usual.

You're even more fired up than usual, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Yes, my motivation is at max 
capacity.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Because now I have one more rival to 
compete against.
choice_data_list:
Rivals are a treasure. By the way, who are 
you talking about?

Rivals are a treasure, you know. By the 
way, who are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"...A fan letter. From an elementary 
schooler, huh."

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter Text
text_block_list.text:
"Running straight ahead with a zoom is 
just so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter Text
text_block_list.text:
“I'll always be cheering for my super 
bright and fast Big Sis!”

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
choice_data_list:
Haha, that typo really raised the bar, 
huh?

Fufu, that typo really raised the bar, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: A typo. I do not believe so.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure they truly believe in it. The 
child who wrote this letter, that is.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
To feelings so earnest and direct, I must 
respond with equal sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry. The path I 
strive for is as straight as a beam of 
light.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, if I just keep getting 
faster— I can reach it."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Once I become the fastest in the country, 
and the fastest in the world, the universe 
is next.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, the light itself 
shall become my opponent.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The fastest thing in this world. A worthy 
opponent indeed.

Calstone Light O vs. the speed of light. 
Will we ever get to see that dream 
showdown?
